entries.6cb445d8227e94a8: Sells domestically produced natural gas, and gas produced by regasifying imported LNG at the Soma LNG Base and other facilities, to customers along its pipeline network, which exceeds 800 km in total length. In Hokkaido, using the Yufutsu LNG receiving terminal, it also provides LNG satellite supply by tank lorry and wheeling supply services. It sells electricity by entrusting power generation to the affiliate Fukushima Gas Hatsuden, and also works on renewable energy such as biomass power generation and on storage battery business.

entries.b0c83b1f47e360c0: Engages in exploration, development, production and sales of crude oil and natural gas in the United States. The consolidated subsidiary Japex (U.S.) Corp. handles tight oil in Texas and Oklahoma, and Verdad Resources Intermediate Holdings LLC, all equity interests in which were acquired in February 2026, handles tight oil and gas in Colorado and Wyoming. The affiliate Gulf Coast LNG Holdings LLC participates in the Freeport LNG project in Texas.
